rules.title: Pattern match
rules.text: Prefer pattern matching and multiple function clauses over nested conditionals.

rules.title: Phoenix contexts
rules.text: Put business logic in context modules, not in controllers or LiveViews.

rules.title: Tagged tuples
rules.text: Return {:ok, value} and {:error, reason} and handle both with with or case.

rules.title: Supervise processes
rules.text: Run long-lived processes under a supervisor and let them crash.

rules.title: mix format and credo
rules.text: Keep mix format and credo clean.
